problem_type: Single-route undirected Orienteering Problem with a distance budget, maximizing the collected visit score

decisions.business: Location visit decisions; visited[i]=1 means location i is visited by the route, visited[i]=0 means it is not visited.
decisions.completeness: Exactly one 0/1 value must be provided for each location; the value for depot_index must be 1, and visited must be fully consistent with the node degrees of selected_links: degree 2 when visited[i]=1, otherwise degree 0.

decisions.business: Undirected link selection decisions; selected_links[i][j]=1 means the direct link between locations i and j belongs to the route, otherwise 0.
decisions.completeness: The complete n_locations×n_locations matrix must be provided; all entries are 0/1, the matrix is symmetric, and the diagonal is 0. The selected links must be consistent with visited and form exactly one connected cycle passing through depot_index, with no branches, dead ends, or separate subtours; counting each undirected link once with i<j, the total distance must not exceed distance_budget.
